ops.text: The harness Bash shell is zsh, where bare `log` resolves to the zsh builtin (watch-login log) instead of /usr/bin/log — so `log show --predicate ...` silently no-ops: piped through `grep -iE ...` the builtin's "too many arguments" error gets filtered out and the query looks like it legitimately returned zero events. This ate four forensic queries during the 2026-07-14 hostname-rename investigation before the `(eval):log:1: too many arguments` tell surfaced through an inverted grep. Unified-log queries must always be written as `/usr/bin/log`.
